name: SurePayroll
summary: SurePayroll lists its Full Service plan at $29 a month plus $7 per employee, with payroll taxes filed and deposited and 2-day direct deposit included. Multi-state payroll costs $9.99 a month more. The same site also shows a $39 starting price without explaining it, so confirm the price before signing up.

facts.text: The home page shows both $29 and $39 monthly prices for the Full Service plan and does not explain the difference.
On its No Tax Filing option the customer files and deposits all payroll taxes.
SurePayroll says payroll history, pay stubs and filings are available online 24/7.

plans.name: Full Service
plans.notes: The site also shows $39 a month for this plan without explanation. First state included; multi-state payroll costs $9.99 a month more

hiddenCosts: The page says a separate fee applies in areas that require local taxes, and does not list it.
Annual W-2 and 1099-NEC forms are billed yearly at a $50 base fee plus $5 per form.

contract.cancellation: The home page says billed monthly, cancel anytime, with no contract.
